doc: `notes::load` reads the project page with `unwrap_or_default()`: any read failure (EACCES here; EIO, a lock, a partial view on a network mount in life) parses as an empty page, and the next `plan` call writes that empty page over the real one by tmp+rename — the goal, the checklist, the prose gone, the tool reporting success. Expected: a page that could not be read is not rewritten; the call fails with the reason.

breaks.detail: the project page was replaced after one unreadable read: 293 → 36 bytes; goal/checklist/notes gone; the plan tool said ['Set 1 item(s).\n\n[ ] 1 Add perimeter() tests — ready']
breaks.where: arbos-core notes.rs load() unwrap_or_default + save_path tmp+rename

breaks.detail: the plan tool reported success while the page it could not read was being replaced

plan_said:
Set 1 item(s).

[ ] 1 Add perimeter() tests — ready
